title: Skeleton 100-Level Advanced AI Structure
purpose: Define a machine-verifiable promotion ladder of 100 advanced AI structural levels above the enterprise system baseline without creating 100 runtime services or duplicating canonical capability ownership.

base_requirement.rule: The 100-level ladder starts above the enterprise operational substrate. Higher cognitive maturity may never weaken enterprise security, tenancy, durability, recovery, or evidence requirements.

semantics.ordinal_rule: Level number expresses promotion maturity and integration order, not a mandatory runtime call chain.
semantics.runtime_rule: Runtime dependencies remain owned by canonical AI construction planes and capability interfaces; the ladder cannot create shadow services or owners.
semantics.promotion_rule: A level may be promoted only when its prerequisites and evidence are satisfied. Each tenth level is a stratum closure gate.
semantics.inheritance_rule: Higher levels inherit every lower non-negotiable authority, safety, provenance, budget, tenant, and recovery invariant.
semantics.rollback_rule: Regression at a lower promoted level invalidates dependent higher-level promotion evidence until requalified.
semantics.implementation_rule: planned_target is not implementation evidence; no level is complete merely because it exists in this plan.

invariants: exactly 100 levels exist with contiguous ordinals 1 through 100
level IDs are exactly L001 through L100
exactly ten strata exist and each contains ten contiguous levels
every tenth level is the closure gate for its stratum
promotion prerequisites only reference the enterprise baseline or lower-numbered levels
every referenced capability plane exists in machine/ai_app_construction.json
every one of the 27 canonical AI construction planes is referenced by at least one advanced stratum
no advanced level can own credentials, canonical conversation state, privileged tool execution, release promotion, or policy merely because it is cognitively advanced
self-improvement levels can propose and evaluate changes but cannot self-approve production promotion
simulation, self-assessment, memory, retrieved evidence, and model output remain non-authoritative unless accepted by their canonical authority
all promoted levels require exact-head evidence and independent verification appropriate to impact

strata.title: Assured Cognitive Substrate
strata.purpose: Make every higher cognitive function typed, attributable, replayable, budgeted, permission-bound, and fail-closed.
strata.authority: Deterministic contracts and canonical state outrank model inference; no learned component may redefine identity, authority, provenance, or durability.
strata.failure: Reject, quarantine, or degrade before allowing ambiguous identity, state, permission, provenance, or budget semantics.

strata.title: Perception and Context Intelligence
strata.purpose: Convert multimodal, heterogeneous, partially untrusted inputs into a bounded trust-aware context representation.
strata.authority: Input interpretation may classify and transform evidence but cannot promote evidence into policy or canonical authority.
strata.failure: Drop, quarantine, externalize, or mark insufficient context rather than silently trusting malformed, oversized, or low-integrity input.

strata.title: Memory and Knowledge Intelligence
strata.purpose: Provide persistent, temporal, semantic, episodic, procedural, and graph knowledge with governed lifecycle and provenance.
strata.authority: Memory is evidence and continuity state, never capability authority; canonical source records outrank derived indexes and summaries.
strata.failure: Degrade to bounded stateless operation or explicit knowledge insufficiency; never cross tenant, resurrect deleted data, or treat stale projection as truth.

strata.title: Deliberative Reasoning and Planning
strata.purpose: Build inspectable problem framing, decomposition, search, causal/quantitative reasoning, uncertainty, and verification.
strata.authority: Reasoning proposes hypotheses and plans; deterministic policy, canonical evidence, and explicit verification decide what may be accepted or acted upon.
strata.failure: Abstain, branch, repair, or escalate when constraints, evidence, calibration, or verification are insufficient.

strata.title: Governed Agency and Tool Action
strata.purpose: Translate intent into bounded, authorized, transactional actions with approvals, sandboxing, receipts, and outcome verification.
strata.authority: Models propose actions only; canonical capability policy, user approval where required, and tool runtime own privileged execution.
strata.failure: Deny, await approval, reconcile ambiguous effects, or terminalize safely; never blindly replay consequential writes.

strata.title: Organizational and Multi-Agent Intelligence
strata.purpose: Coordinate specialized agents, roles, shared work, consensus, conflict resolution, and hierarchical delegation under bounded authority.
strata.authority: Delegation can only reduce or partition parent authority and budget; child workers cannot mint permissions, budget, or canonical state ownership.
strata.failure: Collapse to fewer workers, serialize, escalate conflict, or stop; never amplify recursion, spending, permissions, or side effects.

strata.title: Adaptive Learning and Evaluation
strata.purpose: Learn from governed feedback and evaluation while separating experimentation from production promotion.
strata.authority: Learning produces proposals and evidence; release/evaluation policy owns promotion. Online feedback cannot directly rewrite production policy or behavior.
strata.failure: Retain or roll back to the last verified baseline when evidence is weak, distribution shifts, safety regresses, or metrics conflict.

strata.title: Autonomous Operations and Resilience
strata.purpose: Support bounded goals, scheduled work, interruption recovery, self-diagnosis, resilience, governance reasoning, and risk-aware escalation.
strata.authority: Autonomy is policy-bounded execution over explicit goals and budgets; it never grants itself broader authority or silently converts recommendation into mutation.
strata.failure: Pause, defer, isolate, rollback, request human authority, or enter safe degraded mode when risk, budget, dependencies, or confidence cross policy.

strata.title: Advanced World, Scientific, and Metacognitive Intelligence
strata.purpose: Build world models, simulation, long-horizon reasoning, metacognition, epistemic tracking, stakeholder modeling, creativity, and scientific discovery loops.
strata.authority: Internal models remain hypotheses. Simulations, self-assessments, and stakeholder models cannot override real evidence, consent, policy, or measured outcomes.
strata.failure: Expose uncertainty, compare alternative models, seek evidence, or abstain; never present simulation confidence as observed reality.

strata.title: Frontier Meta-Intelligence and Governed Evolution
strata.purpose: Let the system inspect its architecture, discover gaps, benchmark itself, explore designs, run experiments, propose verified improvements, transfer knowledge, and evolve only through governed promotion.
strata.authority: Self-improvement is proposal-generation plus evidence. The system cannot self-approve code, model, policy, authority, or production promotion.
strata.failure: Freeze evolution, revert to verified baseline, quarantine experiments, or require independent approval whenever evidence, reproducibility, safety, or governance is incomplete.

implementation_program.strategy: Implement by stratum slices and vertical golden journeys, not by creating one package or service per level.
implementation_program.concurrency_rule: Adjacent implementation work may overlap only where canonical owners and lower-level invariants are already stable; promotion remains ordered by closure evidence.
implementation_program.completion_rule: The plan is complete when all 100 levels and gates are structurally validated. The AI system is complete only when each level intended for production has implementation and exact-head evidence.

completion.rule: No level is signed or promoted by this planning change.
